goal: v0.4.0: coverage-probe metadata cache, find recall packet, zero-result diagnosis, diversity eval, site changelog

summary.title: v0.4.0: persist coverage-probe metadata and ship find recall packet
summary.what: PR #99 (merge d65c52f) shipped Sherlog 0.4.0 as eight independently revertable commits: persist sync-time source file metadata in source_file_meta_cache so read-only freshness probes skip re-reading unchanged files; add additive find JSON fields matchedFields and sessionMessageCount; add structured zeroResults diagnosis with refine hints; add duplicate-family diversity eval metrics without changing ranking; teach the skill provenance/zero-result loop; delete stale docs/workflows process artifacts; add a bilingual site changelog; bump the package to 0.4.0.
summary.why: Product review found coverage freshness probes re-read up to 64KB of every source file on each status/find just to recover content-derived metadata already computed at sync time. Agents also lacked machine-readable hit provenance and trustworthy zero-result reasons, so they could not choose a read strategy or distinguish a fresh miss from stale coverage. Eval diversity and the public changelog were unblocked slices of the same release.
summary.user_goal: v0.4.0: coverage-probe metadata cache, find recall packet, zero-result diagnosis, diversity eval, site changelog

decisions.chose: Persist scan-time file metadata in source_file_meta_cache at sync (the only state writer). Read-only probes resolve unchanged files by mtime+size and fall back to a content scan otherwise. Cached values come from the same scan whose fingerprints were written to coverage.
decisions.rationale: Extends int_19d3c24f, which reused collectFiles in-memory within a single status invocation. Cross-invocation probes still paid a full content scan. Persisting the sync-time scan keeps freshness semantics byte-identical without making status/find writers.
rejected: Trust stored coverage fingerprints without checking raw session metadata
Have find/status write the cache (would violate sync-as-only-writer)

decisions.point: How find should expose hit provenance without breaking the JSON contract
decisions.chose: Additive recall-packet fields on every find result: matchedFields (message vs title/summary/compact/reasoningSummary) and sessionMessageCount as the read-page cost ceiling.
decisions.rationale: Agents need provenance to choose read-range vs read-page. Additive fields keep existing consumers working.
rejected: Replace snippet/matchSource with a new result shape
Encode provenance only in human text output

decisions.point: How to diagnose zero results without implicit sync
decisions.chose: Structured zeroResults with reason fresh_miss / stale_or_missing_coverage / coverage_not_confirmed, plus deterministic broadening suggestions. Read-only commands still never sync.
decisions.rationale: Continues int_1068ce71: find stays read-only and returns nextAction. Empty results need an explicit reason so agents do not treat a stale miss as proof of absence, and do not retry the same over-constrained query.
rejected: Implicitly running sync inside find on zero results
Returning only nextAction without a reason enum

decisions.point: Whether to change ranking for duplicate-family diversity
decisions.chose: Add a non-blocking diversity eval case and top-result diversity metrics. Leave ranking unchanged (eval-first).
decisions.rationale: Measure collapse before changing the ranker. Avoid hardcoding queries or collapsing families in production without eval evidence.
rejected: Shipping a stage-2 diversity reranker in this release
Hardcoding query/session ids to pass dogfood

rejected.alternative: Treat the merge commit d65c52f as the sealed claim
rejected.reason: .mainline/config.toml skips ^Merge pull request ; the eight PR commits are the uncovered units. The merge commit remains skipped.

review_notes: Post-hoc backfill after the cloud agent that authored PR #99 could not run mainline. Claims the eight pushed commits listed in start --commits; merge d65c52f is skipped by config.

Local 2026-08-13 verification on this machine: npm run check 238/238 after better-sqlite3 ABI rebuild; dogfood 16 cases hardFail 0 (9 candidate fails); real-corpus find p50 lower than 2026-06-26 snapshot despite 3.45x messages; eval:perf uses --best-effort so post-sync status can remain stale until a complete sync; after complete Codex sync, installed-binary fresh coverage probe ~567ms vs June 1438ms.
Fingerprint files_touched lists load-bearing paths; the PR also deleted docs/workflows/** process-trace artifacts and touched remaining source adapters/tests.

architectural_claims: sync remains the only Sherlog state writer; read-only coverage probes may read a cache populated at sync time
find JSON gains additive recall-packet fields without replacing matchSource/snippet
zero-result diagnosis is structured and still never implies sync
behavioral_changes: status/find freshness probes resolve unchanged files from source_file_meta_cache instead of re-reading file heads
find results include matchedFields and sessionMessageCount
zero-result find JSON includes zeroResults.reason and suggestedQueries
acceptance gate reports top-result diversity metrics

data_model_changes.name: source_file_meta_cache
data_model_changes.migration_notes: Created on next open/sync of the existing SQLite index; no rebuild required. Cache misses fall back to content scan.

migration_notes: Existing indexes gain source_file_meta_cache on the next sync; stale cache rows are ignored when mtime+size differ.
